# Broker Leveltime

## [v3.0](https://github.com/laric/broker_leveltime/tree/v3.0) (2026-10-14)
[Full Changelog](https://github.com/laric/broker_leveltime/compare/v2.91...v3.0) [Previous Releases](https://github.com/laric/broker_leveltime/releases)

- Update GitHub Actions checkout action version  
- Updated toc  
- Update releases.yml to package and release for all game versions; update interface version in broker\_leveltime.toc  
- Forever base (#7)  
    * Forever toc value  
    * Refactor release workflow to streamline packaging for Forever version  
    * Enhance documentation and improve tooltip formatting for time tracking  
    * Clean up and document Leveltime, fix tooltip not showing  
    - Extract FormatDuration and AddLevelHistory helpers, add doc comments  
    - Store explicit level field on saved entries, migrate existing data  
    - Drop custom OnEnter/OnLeave; let display addons anchor the tooltip  
    - Resolve max level at call time (MAX\_PLAYER\_LEVEL was nil at load,  
      which errored OnTooltipShow)
